description: Conservative per-profile save and persistent-data inventory. Paths are candidates based on upstream documentation, not proof of actual runtime writes. All paths are relative to the environment's /home/emu unless explicitly stated otherwise.

profiles.notes: No supported runner is enabled by this profile. No save path is inferred or created.
No verified path contract is recorded for the pinned Linux payload. Inspect the selected build's user-data location before moving or redirecting files.
The home tree is snapshotted, but no exact save path is approved here because packaging/data-directory behavior must be confirmed for the selected runner. Do not create generic symlinks.

home_paths.purpose: Upstream Linux user directory; includes settings and default memory-card/save-state data. Nested save paths may be configured in the emulator.

profiles.notes: XDG_DATA_HOME is not set by the current image, so the documented fallback is /home/emu/.local/share/duckstation. The existing BIOS mount is nested under this user directory.

home_paths.purpose: Default file-based memory cards in the current Linux user-data layout.
Save-state directory seen in current Linux user-data layouts; not a replacement for normal in-game memory-card saves.

profiles.notes: Open Data Directory in PCSX2 is authoritative if the selected build or configuration overrides the path. Save states can be version-sensitive; use memory cards for long-term game saves.

home_paths.purpose: Common Memory Stick savedata directory for Linux.
PPSSPP's documented Linux user folder; other Memory Stick content may be below it.

profiles.notes: Confirm the chosen Memory Stick folder in PPSSPP settings. This entry records a documented default, not a guarantee for every custom configuration.
Save data is associated with the emulator's virtual user storage. The exact user-data directory must be discovered from the selected build/runtime before mapping.
No supported full-system runner is configured; no save path is inferred.
The Windows/Wine execution path can change the user-data root. Confirm the prefix and Xenia content directory before attempting any save redirection.
No supported full-system runner is configured; no save path is inferred.
Persistent Xbox content can be part of a virtual HDD/system image and configuration, not a generic per-game save folder. Back up the complete environment home and separately supplied system images.
Do not assume a portable save location from the executable filename. Inspect the selected build's user-data and virtual-system storage before mapping.

home_paths.purpose: Save data within the MLC path configured by EMUSTACK_CEMU_MLC_PATH.

profiles.notes: Cemu's MLC contains system data and saved games. Treat it as console storage, not as a regular folder of interchangeable save files. The current image sets the MLC root to /home/emu/.local/share/Cemu/mlc01.

home_paths.purpose: Default Linux/XDG global user directory; memory cards and Wii user-data reside inside its profile structure.

profiles.notes: Older/legacy builds may use ~/.dolphin-emu, and portable/custom builds can override the directory. Runtime verification is required before migration.
The save data depends on the selected user-data/NAND configuration. Do not infer a stable path until the chosen AppImage/build is launched and inspected.
Firmware and save-data paths vary with configuration and build. Keep the complete per-environment home backed up until a runtime trace establishes specific locations.
Battery saves may be written beside a ROM or to a configured save location. Because /games is read-only in EmuStack, verify and configure a writable save directory before declaring saves functional.
Save-type files and paths depend on the frontend/plugins/configuration. The read-only /games mount means the default path must be tested; no writable path is assumed.
Save and state paths can depend on the selected build/settings. Validate actual writes against the read-only /games mount before promising persistence.
The exact Linux user-data/save directory depends on the selected build and configuration. Discover it at runtime before mapping or migrating data.
